issues.text: 3 runs connect to the control's data bus. No more than 2 runs may connect directly (the screw terminals and the J1 and J2 connectors all count).
Run 1: the M1DBHR must be mounted inside the M1 enclosure and cannot be remoted. 15 ft of feed cable is too far.
Run 1: the M1DBHR has exactly 4 branches (found 2).
Run 1, branch 1 is 4100 ft of cable. The longest a branch may be is 4000 ft.
Run 1, branch 2 is 3300 ft, close to the 4000 ft limit. Use 18 to 22 AWG (24 AWG is the minimum).
Run 2: the M1DBHR is connected to the control with a short 4-conductor cable and mounted in the M1 enclosure (5 ft is long).
Run 2: the M1DBHR has exactly 4 branches (found 1).
Run 2, branch 1: home run "X" has no device to terminate.
Run 3: the M1DBHR has exactly 4 branches (found 0).
More than two M1DBHR hubs on one control. The most allowed is two, and an M1DBHR cannot sit on a branch of another or act as an extender.

checklist.title: Control
items: JP3 (terminating jumper on the M1 control): REMOVE it. With two runs, the far end of each run is terminated instead.
The data bus must have exactly two terminating points in total, never more.

checklist.title: Run 1
items: Mount the M1DBHR inside the M1 enclosure. Connect its +, A, B and − terminals to the control's +VKP, DATA A, DATA B and NEG with a short 4-conductor cable (15 ft). If the hub is powered from an auxiliary supply, do not connect +VKP and join all the negatives.
JP1 (terminates the input from the control): INSTALL it.
Branch 1: home run "A" (2500 ft): Keypad (address 1); home run "B" (1600 ft): Keypad (address 2).
Branch 1: terminate the last device of each home run and REMOVE JP2.
Branch 2: terminate the last device (Keypad (address 3)) AND fit JP3 on the hub. That is the branch's two terminations.

checklist.title: Run 2
items: Mount the M1DBHR inside the M1 enclosure. Connect its +, A, B and − terminals to the control's +VKP, DATA A, DATA B and NEG with a short 4-conductor cable (5 ft). If the hub is powered from an auxiliary supply, do not connect +VKP and join all the negatives.
JP1 (terminates the input from the control): INSTALL it.
Branch 1: terminate the last device (?) AND fit JP2 on the hub. That is the branch's two terminations.

checklist.title: Run 3
items: Mount the M1DBHR inside the M1 enclosure. Connect its +, A, B and − terminals to the control's +VKP, DATA A, DATA B and NEG with a short 4-conductor cable (1 ft). If the hub is powered from an auxiliary supply, do not connect +VKP and join all the negatives.
JP1 (terminates the input from the control): INSTALL it.

checklist.title: Addresses to set
items: After setting the addresses, run Bus Module Enrollment (installer programming, or Live > Modules in this editor). Devices added later must be enrolled too.
